'''Pooja Naberrie''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from [[Naboo]] whose [[Parent|mother]] was [[Sola Naberrie]]; she also had a [[Naberrie family|sister]], [[Ryoo Naberrie|Ryoo]]. She attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] of her aunt, [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], in [[19 BBY]].

==Biography==
Pooja Naberrie was a [[human]]<ref name="Episode III" /> [[Gender|female]] whose [[Parent|mother]] was [[Sola Naberrie]], a member of the [[Naberrie family]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> from the [[planet]] [[Naboo]];<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> she also had a sister named [[Ryoo Naberrie|Ryoo]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> She was a [[Youngling|child]] when the [[Clone Wars]] [[Empire Day|ended]]<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the same [[Standard year|year]] that her aunt,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], [[Death|died]] in [[Reproduction|childbirth]]. Naberrie attended Amidala's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] [[Funeral|ceremony]] in the [[Theed|capital city]] of the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[homeworld]], shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Episode III" />

==Personality and traits==
Naberrie had [[Color|light brown]] curly [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Equipment==
At times, Naberrie wore an elegant, traditional children's [[Clothing|dress]] made from natural materials.<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> At her aunt's funeral, she wore a black dress to show her mourning.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pooja Naberrie was played by the actress [[Hayley Mooy]].<ref name="Episode III" /> She first appeared in a deleted scene in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] that was set at the Naboo family residence.<ref name="Episode II deleted">{{Film|II}} {{Del}}</ref> She appears at the end of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] attending Padmé Amidala's funeral and is named in the film's closing credits.<ref name="Episode III" />
